en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 458 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Muhammad bin Ali Kufi from Wuhaib bin Hafas from Abu Basir from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said: “
The name of Imam Qaim (a.s) will be announced on the 23rd night and he will reappear on the day of Ashura, on which Imam Husain (a.s) was martyred.”
